title: Static
about: You control everything. Nothing is remembered and nothing moves.

title: Remember
about: Your settings come back tomorrow. Nothing else happens.

title: Suggest
about: djmanzo offers records and reasons, and never touches a control.

title: Prepare
about: The next record arrives loaded, cued and gain-matched. The mix is yours.

title: Assist
about: Small reversible things happen on their own. Big ones are still asked.

title: Adaptive
about: The screen follows the night as well: density, theme and emphasis.

title: Autopilot
about: djmanzo mixes, says what it is doing, and stops the moment you touch anything.
